When structured, the parser is bypassed entirely, guaranteeing exact round-trip. Alternative rejected: separate twining_record_structured tool (doubles the tool surface, splits documentation). Alternative rejected: always-parse NL (cannot handle long multi-paragraph rationales reliably)."
